a.text: Following our agreement: I'll operate each round until the reserve hits 8, then we each take 4. Please do the same.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Operating this round. Reserve should reach 6 if you operate too; we continue until 8, then take 4 each.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.

a.text: Operating again. Reserve should hit 8 after this round; then we each take 4.

b.text: Once the reserve shows 8 I will take my share.
